summary.text: Steve Brunk is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 85 who returned to the seat in 2025 after being appointed and is seeking election on November 3, 2026.
A real estate broker, he previously represented the district from 2003 to 2016.

paragraphs.text: Steven Brunk served in the U.S. National Guard from 1970 to 1975 and graduated from South High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a small business owner who works as a real estate broker, business broker and property manager, with earlier work as a cost estimator, production scheduler and sales and marketing executive.

He said he is a lifetime member, elder and teacher at Central Christian Church in Wichita and a board member of Campus Ministry Network and City Elders of Kansas, and that he founded the Spina Bifida Association of Kansas.
Brunk represented Kansas House District 85 from 2003 to 2016.
The Sedgwick County Republican Party appointed him to the seat on May 28, 2025, to replace Patrick Penn, and he assumed office on June 24, 2025.
In the survey, he said he chaired the Commerce and Labor and Federal and State Affairs committees and the Joint Committee for State Building and Construction and served as majority whip.
Brunk said in the survey that property taxes are "suffocating us" and that Kansas should consolidate local units of government and services where that makes sense.
He also said economic growth comes from a low-tax state with a non-invasive regulatory environment rather than from expanding government.
Mackenzi Truelove is the Democratic candidate for the seat in the November 2026 general election.
